issues.jp_before: 母[はは]の電話[でんわ]の声[こえ]から、{どうも/どうやら|av-doumo}祖母[そぼ]は元気[げんき]がないようだと思[おも]った。
issues.problem: English was awkward and mixed tenses ('I felt that Grandma doesn't seem to be doing well').
issues.action: Rewrote en: 'From my mother's voice on the phone, I got the impression that Grandma wasn't doing well.'

issues.jp_before: どうも最近[さいきん]、父[ちち]は{疲[つか]れているようです|av-doumo}。
issues.problem: らしいです is equally natural here with the same English, but it was not listed (the other lines in the file list both endings).
issues.action: Added 疲[つか]れているらしいです as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: どうも彼女[かのじょ]は日本語[にほんご]が{わかっていないようです|av-doumo}。
issues.problem: らしいです is equally natural about a third person, but it was not listed.
issues.action: Added わかっていないらしいです as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: どうも昨日[きのう]食[た]べた物[もの]が{合[あ]わなかったようだ|av-doumo}。
issues.problem: The distractor 合わなかったほうがいい is not a well-formed expression (the standard form is ないほうがいい).
issues.action: Replaced that distractor with 合[あ]わないほうがいい.

issues.jp_before: どうも彼[かれ]は嘘[うそ]を{ついているようだ/ついているらしい|av-doumo}。
issues.problem: lv 2 was too high: 嘘をつく and the どうも pattern are N3 at most.

issues.jp_before: {ぜひ|av-zehi}家族[かぞく]みんなで遊[あそ]びに来[き]てください。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the item '日本へ来たら、ぜひうちに遊びに来てください'; the English was unnatural ('all of your family'); the file was also weighted heavily toward ぜひ (どうか was under-represented).
issues.action: Deleted the item and replaced it with a どうか plea: {どうか|av-zehi}このことは誰[だれ]にも言[い]わないでください。 The distractors ぜひ, どうぞ and たぶん are all impossible before a negative request.

issues.jp_before: どうぞお気[き]を付[つ]けて{お帰[かえ]りください|av-zehi}。
issues.problem: The why spelled the answer as おかえりください instead of the form used in the item.
issues.action: Changed the why to read お帰りください.
